title: Replication visibility and missing metrics
summary: Replication statistics describe connected senders. Lag durations can be NULL after an idle standby catches up. Declare expected replicas; missing or NULL evidence must not become zero backlog.
checks: Check recovery role, expected sender count and known replay positions.
limitations: Disconnected replicas require declared topology; observations cover connected senders.
